title: Anthropic prices initial public offering
gist: Anthropic, PBC priced its IPO of Class A common stock at $83.00 per share for 980 million shares (956.4M primary, 23.6M secondary), to trade on Nasdaq Global Select under 'ANT' from November 19, 2026, with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley named as prospectus contacts and a 147M-share underwriter option.

insights.claim: Anthropic, PBC priced its initial public offering of Class A common stock at $83.00 per share, with 980,000,000 shares offered in total.
insights.speaker: Anthropic Blog
insights.so_what: At $83 x 980M shares the base deal raises roughly $81bn gross, making it one of the largest IPOs ever and a major liquidity/supply event for AI equity.
insights.quote: priced its initial public offering of its Class A common stock at $83.00 per share

insights.claim: Of the 980 million shares in Anthropic's IPO, 956,351,354 are primary shares sold by the company and only 23,648,646 are sold by existing selling stockholders, so the deal is overwhelmingly a primary capital raise.
insights.speaker: Anthropic Blog
insights.so_what: A ~97.6% primary deal signals the cash is for the company (compute/capex), not insider exits — limited early-holder selling at listing.

insights.claim: Anthropic Class A shares were expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market on November 19, 2026 under the ticker symbol 'ANT', with the offering closing on November 20, 2026.
insights.speaker: Anthropic Blog
insights.so_what: New listed pure-play frontier-AI ticker (ANT) — watch index-inclusion timelines and its effect on AI-basket and Nasdaq flows.
insights.locator: The shares are expected to begin trading

insights.claim: Anthropic granted its IPO underwriters a 30-day option to buy up to 147,000,000 additional Class A shares, a greenshoe of 15% of the base deal.
insights.speaker: Anthropic Blog
insights.so_what: The greenshoe gives underwriters a stabilization tool in the first 30 days of ANT trading; exercise would add ~$12bn at the offer price.
insights.locator: In addition, Anthropic has granted the underwriters

insights.claim: Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC and Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC are the named prospectus contacts for Anthropic's IPO, whose registration statement the SEC declared effective on November 18, 2026.
insights.speaker: Anthropic Blog
insights.so_what: Lead-bank fee and league-table tailwind for GS and MS from a mega-IPO.
insights.locator: A registration statement relating to these securities
